title: Improving the Optimization Landscape of Matrix Completion with $\epsilon$-close Surrogates
abstract: arXiv:2610.41455v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Non-convex optimization is central to machine learning and AI, yet unlike its convex counterpart, it still lacks a general and principled framework. In this work, we try to highlight the importance of combining noisy perturbations with over-parametrization mathematically under the classic setting of matrix completion (MC). Matrix completion is an important non-convex recovery problem in which only a subset of a matrix's entries is observed, and the remaining entries must be recovered using low-rank constraints. This problem is notoriously difficult because observations are limited. However, we show that by injecting $\epsilon$-level perturbations into the nullspace of the observation mask, we can construct noisy matrix sensing surrogates whose solutions remain $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon)$-close to the ground truth with valid restricted isometry property (RIP) constants. translated_title: 通过ε-接近的代理问题改进矩阵补全的优化图景
translated_abstract: 非凸优化是机器学习和人工智能的核心，但与凸优化不同，它仍然缺乏一个通用且有原则的框架。在这项工作中，我们试图在矩阵补全（MC）这一经典设置下，从数学上强调将噪声扰动与过参数化相结合的重要性。矩阵补全是一个重要的非凸恢复问题，其中仅观测到矩阵的部分条目，其余条目必须借助低秩约束来恢复。由于观测有限，这个问题是出了名的困难。然而，我们证明，通过向观测掩码的零空间注入ε级扰动，我们可以构造噪声矩阵感知代理问题，其解与真值保持O(ε)的接近度，并具有有效的受限等距性质（RIP）常数。RIP的存在进一步使得强大的张量框架能够被应用……
tldr: 该论文提出通过向观测掩码零空间注入ε级扰动来构造噪声矩阵感知代理问题，使矩阵补全的解与真值保持O(ε)接近且具有有效RIP常数，从而将噪声扰动与过参数化结合，改善了非凸优化的优化图景。
en_tdlr: This work shows that injecting ε-level perturbations into the nullspace of the observation mask yields noisy matrix sensing surrogates whose solutions remain O(ε)-close to the ground truth with valid RIP constants, improving the optimization landscape of matrix completion by combining noisy perturbations with over-parametrization.
